label: Midday Update
headline: S&P -1.02% at 11:33, VIX 21.1, Brent $93.47, Empire +7.8 vs +18.0 expected
stance: AI-linked stocks led the drop before Tuesday's chip results. Rates held flat and oil fell, so this is an equity selloff.

scorecard.call: Tuesday's chip results decide this week's equity direction.
scorecard.actual: S&P fell 1.02% by 11:33, a day before the results. Direction moved early.

scorecard.call: Oil fell overnight despite two more tanker hits in Hormuz.
scorecard.actual: Brent $93.47 at 11:23, -2.47%. WTI near $87 at 11:17. The decline continued.

scorecard.call: Empire State survey, 8:30: first factory read for November.
scorecard.actual: +7.8 vs +18.0 expected at 8:30, down from +25.5 in October.

bullets: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq opened lower at 9:30. AI-linked names led the slide through 11:23.
10y 5.14% at 11:18, -1.3bp vs Friday. MOVE 99.2. Bonds did not join the selloff.
Commerce Department rule restricts China's remote access to advanced chips (10:22).
Houthi forces within 100km of Aden after government troops left Bab el-Mandeb positions (11:00). Oil fell anyway.

items.head: Nvidia lower ahead of Tuesday's results
items.body: Reports after Tuesday's close, ~4:20pm ET. Two more analyst target cuts (11:18). Trump called Huang's return 'not a bad idea' (9:46).

watch.head: Houthi advance near Bab el-Mandeb
watch.body: Saudi crude exports are at risk if Red Sea shipping is hit.

watch.head: Retail sales, Nov 17, 8:30
watch.body: Tier-1 consumer data before the FOMC on Dec 9.
